stacks.title: When in Doubt, Stop
stacks.what_it_is: A small check that runs before your agent calls any tool.
stacks.what_it_does: Stops the call when a field is missing or a permission answer is unknown, instead of guessing and letting it through.

stacks.title: Ask Before You Delete
stacks.what_it_is: A short rule list for the steps that always go to a person.
stacks.what_it_does: Makes payments, deletes and other can't-undo steps wait for a human yes, whatever the agent or any check says.

stacks.title: Pin Your Tool Definitions
stacks.what_it_is: A fingerprint of each tool you approved.
stacks.what_it_does: Notices when a tool's name, description or inputs change after you approved it, and asks again instead of running.

stacks.title: Tool Results Are Data, Not Orders
stacks.what_it_is: A system rule plus a cleanup step for anything a tool returns.
stacks.what_it_does: Treats web pages, files and tool replies as information to check, so a fetched page can't take over your agent.

stacks.title: Said vs. Did Log
stacks.what_it_is: Two separate records for every run.
stacks.what_it_does: Lets you prove afterwards whether a bad tool reply turned into an action, and keeps secrets out of what the model sees.

stacks.title: Token Defrag
stacks.what_it_is: A checklist for doing the same work with fewer tokens.
stacks.what_it_does: Cuts what you pay every turn: keep tool lists steady, drop old tool output, fetch things once, and turn on only the tools this turn needs.

stacks.title: Session Budget Guard
stacks.what_it_is: A hard ceiling on how many tokens one run can use.
stacks.what_it_does: Stops the run with a plain message when it hits the ceiling, instead of retrying forever and running up the bill.

stacks.title: Prompts in Git, Keys Out
stacks.what_it_is: A folder layout, ignore list and commit check for your prompts.
stacks.what_it_does: Lets you review and roll back prompt changes like code, and blocks a commit that contains a key.

stacks.title: Retry With a Key
stacks.what_it_is: One key per real-world write, reused on every retry.
stacks.what_it_does: Stops a timeout-and-retry from creating a second charge, ticket or pull request.

stacks.title: Pin Your Model IDs
stacks.what_it_is: An exact model name in your config, plus a check that enforces it.
stacks.what_it_does: Keeps your agent on the model you tested, so a vendor default or a quiet redirect doesn't change it without you noticing.
